hook: A model that usually needs a server now runs on one gaming PC
hooks: 125B model on one gaming PC: 94 tokens/s on RTX 5070
A model that usually needs a server now runs on one gaming PC
what_happened: Strata runs the 125B Qwen3.8‑Flash‑Next on one gaming PC, reaching 94 tokens/s on an RTX 5070 with its fastest size (Q2_0).
try_it: git clone https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata, then START-HERE.bat (Windows) or ./setup.sh (Linux). Needs an NVIDIA/AMD GPU with 12 GB+ VRAM, 32 GB+ RAM, ~80 GB free disk.
why_it_matters: A model that usually needs a server now runs on one gaming PC, in compressed form.
the_catch: Compressed to about 2-3 bits ("larger sizes are a bit smarter"); the PC may stop responding 1-3 minutes while loading. Measured on two PCs only.
caption: Run the 125‑billion‑parameter Qwen 3.8‑Flash‑Next model on your own gaming PC with Strata: 94 tokens per second on an RTX 5070 with its fastest size. Have you ever imagined a server‑grade AI model running on your desktop?
alt_text: The carousel explains that Strata lets a consumer PC run the 125‑billion‑parameter Qwen 3.8‑Flash‑Next model at 94 tokens per second on an RTX 5070, in compressed form, with notes on hardware requirements and limitations.

es.hook: Un modelo que normalmente necesita un servidor ahora se ejecuta en una PC gamer
es.what_happened: Strata ejecuta el modelo Qwen3.8‑Flash‑Next de 125 B en una PC gamer, alcanzando 94 tokens por segundo en una RTX 5070 con su tamaño más rápido (Q2_0).
es.try_it: Clona el repositorio con git clone https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata, luego ejecuta START-HERE.bat (Windows) o ./setup.sh (Linux). Necesita una GPU NVIDIA/AMD con 12 GB o más de VRAM, al menos 32 GB de RAM y unos 80 GB de espacio libre en disco.
es.why_it_matters: Un modelo que normalmente requiere un servidor ahora se ejecuta en una sola PC gamer, en forma comprimida.
es.the_catch: Comprimido a aproximadamente 2‑3 bits («los tamaños mayores son un poco más inteligentes»); la PC puede dejar de responder entre 1 y 3 minutos mientras carga. Medido solo en dos PCs.
